name: ds-rag-embedder-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. Fine-tune of BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (33M, 384-dim) for data-science / ML documentation retrieval in RAG pipelines, trained on 600+ passages covering metrics, leakage, cross-validation, imbalance, MLOps, deployment and experiment design. Identical tensor set to the base; requires a query prefix ('Represent this Data Science question for retrieving relevant documentation: ') with documents encoded bare. The card prints the base as a ROW in the same table, not a column, and also prints all-MiniLM-L6-v2 as an independent third arm. Read the ceiling hard: Recall@5 goes 0.609 -> 1.000, which means the 600-passage eval set (the author's own waghelad/ds-rag-eval-v1) is too easy to discriminate at k=5, and only Recall@1 / MRR / nDCG@10 carry information. No harness, seed or CI printed. Apache-2.0, repo created 2026-08-14. Confidence 0.4.
